spans.text: The streets are filled with the sound of gunfire, running footsteps, and desperate screams. Bullets and radiation particles are billowing in the air.
The garrison troops' defense line at the bottom of the quarantine wall is severely compromised and on the brink of being devoured by the endless waves of ELIDs.
This is the Garrison of Purification Tower 16! ELIDs have gathered beneath the tower in our blind spot and are attempting to scale the structure! Can somebody fire at them?!
Garrison of Gate E4 is requesting more ammo! Can anyone spare a drone to deliver supplies to us?!
The steady bursts of gunfire start thinning out over time. Wails come through the comms channel here and there...and even these are becoming more and more infrequent.
Dammit, I'm out of ammo!
Here, my last mag! Use it well!
Shit, we can't even tell where they're coming from! We've got to move to another... Ahhhh!
The ELIDs have gotten through here as well?! At this rate...
Bang bang bang!
Huh...? You're...the allied T-Doll from before?
This place won't hold, retreat!
...Are you kidding me? I'll never run off on my own and leave my fellow soldiers behind!
Is this really the time to worry about your honor?! You could still make it if you leave now!
If you have time to talk such nonsense, why don't you get us more ammo?! The fight isn't over yet!
...Why are you doing this? What good will sacrificing yourself achieve?
You don't understand, do you?! Our home is right behind us!
If you can't fight, then this is no place for a little girl like you!
M4 shakes her head and leaves the garrison fort at the quarantine wall.
...Well? Did anyone take you up on your advice?
They...all refused to withdraw...for many different reasons.
Some were trembling so violently they couldn't even speak clearly, while some hid their fear by making jokes.
Others busied themselves with scavenging for equipment from the deceased to add to their ammo reserves.
A few merely saluted M4 in silence.
Not knowing how to face them, M4 had to run away from these soldiers who were determined to fight to their dying breath.
I figured as much. The ones who wanted to run would have fled right after the first explosion.
No matter why these people are so determined to stay...they've already missed the chance to escape.
I'm sure they all know what they're doing.
You go on ahead. I'll stick around for a bit to see if anyone needs help.
I have no intention of waiting for you, so I'm already gone.
Is that so...? Then it's for the best.
What about you? Don't forget Ange's orders.
There's still something that I've got to do.
In the end, you're the one who can't stop obsessing over things that are none of your business.
I'm very interested in seeing what will come of you. Make sure you don't die out there.
After the communication with AK-12, M4 goes up to the rooftop of a building and studies the breaches on the quarantine wall from above.
Even though the situation is utterly hopeless, flashes of retaliating gunfire can still be seen occasionally from around the wall, followed by echoing gunshots.
...Ange, do you read?
Loud and clear. Go ahead.
I...just got an idea that might put a stop to the ELIDs.
I ordered to you to fall back to the rendezvous point. Don't do anything unnecessary.
Listen. I have the fire support platform and plenty of ammo with me. If I detonate them all at once, I could seal up the first opening on the wall.
That's way too dangerous! The breach is already swarming with ELIDs!
Besides, even if you plug the first opening, what about the second one? You only have that one case—
I'm sorry, Ange... But I've got to do something for them...
Just as M4 is about to turn around and set out for the quarantine wall, a searing heat starts burning in her chest.
Her neural cloud feels like a boiling kettle, and there's a sharp ringing in her ears.
(Groans)
You're too important. You shouldn't put yourself in such danger.
Why...are you stopping me?!
I'm surprised how much they moved you. The fact that you can still feel heartbroken means you haven't become completely heartless.
But you still haven't fulfilled your purpose.
Do you hear me, M4? M4!
...Yes.
M4 comes to her senses and nods.
Just calm down, okay?
Don't be rash. Our strength is limited. Right now I need every one of you to work with me.
But they're still fighting! The people on the wall... If we don't do something...
We didn't have the time to assess if the quarantine wall could even withstand a third explosion after the damage it had already sustained in the first two.
I honestly won't be surprised if your trick doesn't solve the problem but brings down the entire wall instead, which is going to create an even bigger problem.
I know...you're right. But still...
Lieutenant Dragović and his men have done their duty. There's nothing we can do to prevent their sacrifices.
That's exactly why we can't let their deaths be in vain.
Their deaths will really be worthless if we give the saboteurs what they want.
Surely you don't want that, M4!
...Right.
M4 lets out a long sigh and her shoulders finally droop.
I just...feel so helpless...
The independent neural cloud that Persica has given you is a precious asset, but this isn't the time to squander it.
I didn't want to interrupt this Chicken Soup for the Soul moment, but AR-15 just got in touch.
They seem to be in big trouble.
Ange, do you copy?
I'm receiving you. Is it done, AR-15?
Sorry Ange, I've located the Node, but it isn't going well at all!

Things are rapidly getting out of hand. I've sent you our location. Sangvis Ferri has engaged the White Faction in battle with M16 in command. I'm afraid we're going to have to fight whoever is left after this fight...
M16...? Sangvis Ferri...?
What a messy situation. Alright, things aren't looking too good on our end either, but we'll send reinforcements to you ASAP.
Hang in there.
Did you hear that, M4? The fight isn't over yet. In any case, come and regroup with me quickly. We've got to aid 15 and 94 ASAP.
Roger that.
Click.
Ange looks up at the sky and sighs heavily.
How unusual.
What do you mean?
I've never heard you sigh before. At least you've never done it in my presence. Now I'm curious.
I've given another order that forced her to betray her own will. I hurt her deeply again...
You made the right call. We can't save everyone.
We can't save everyone, you say...? Sometimes I feel like we can't even save ourselves...
...In the streets of Belgrade.
With her back to the quarantine wall, M4 continues on her course to the rendezvous point.
It should be in this direction... Hmm?
M4A1 points her muzzle at the source of a strange noise, only to find a soldier lying by the road.
The pile of ELID corpses next to him is practically a small mound.
(Groans)
Are you alright?
M4 hurries over to the soldier's side. His protective gear is in tatters and the man is severely injured.
Even so, M4 drags him off the streets into a house nearby that provides temporary shelter from the radiation storm.
...D-do me a favor.
I'll do what I can. Tell me what you need.
Make...it quick... Put a bullet...through my brain...
...I can't...
It hurts... My stomach and my head... These are the early symptoms of the change...
My fingers...are so stiff...I can't pull the trigger myself...
I don't want to...turn into those monsters... I want to live...my final moments...as a human being...cough, cough!
...I understand.
M4 lifts her weapon and aims at the wounded soldier.
He raises his right arm slowly and laboriously to salute M4.
Bang bang bang!
You didn't tremble. You did the right thing.
I didn't...even have a choice.
All I could do was watch as everything around me got destroyed.
Failure after failure. One dead comrade after another. Yet I still...
It's no different this time. I couldn't do anything to help.
Don't blame yourself. Those people gave their lives for what they believed to be a worthy cause.
Just look at this! Was it really worth it?
She flees the house and sprints through the streets of Belgrade without stopping, running past horror after horror.
Civilians convulsing on the ground, suffering from acute radiation sickness.
Vehicles abandoned haphazardly on the road. Screams coming from deserted alleyways.
I don't care about my own safety. If my sacrifice could change all this, I'd gladly give my life.
And yet...
The voice answers in the same emotionless tone.
It doesn't work like that, and you know it.
Like those soldiers, you shared the same values and were willing to sacrifice everything.
But you know that won't change anything, which is why you left in search of some other solution.
I'm just telling the truth. Facing the facts isn't a shameful thing.
There is still much for you, who have just gotten the key to leave your cage, to learn about this world.
Were you telling the truth when I met Mastermind?
I was, you simply didn't fully understand my point.
Our enemies are also searching for what we're after.
If we don't hurry, the same disaster will happen a second or third time.
What exactly are we looking for? What is this "Pike" Node that Ange mentioned? Answer me.
The Pike Node is just the beginning. We need a full picture of the black box.
If someone unworthy covets the power it brings, they will try to obtain it at the cost of everything else.
The only one who has the right to touch it is you.
First, the whole AR Team risked their own lives for me, now so many more people have died right before my eyes.
This power has brought nothing but misery. Is it really so valuable?
I never wanted the right to touch it in the first place!
Nobody does.
No one is born into this world of their own free will, just as no Doll has any say in regard to their own creation.
Everyone is burdened by a certain mission as they come into the world...
But you are special. You've been given a destiny that others can't even dream of.
There's nothing special about it. Everyone has their own curse.
Mine just happens to be especially bad.
Perhaps you haven't given this much thought because you've been living with your man-made shackles for too long.
Facing one's destiny is always painful, but it is up to each individual to find joy in this kind of pain.
All I can tell you is that if you fulfill your destiny, you will save far more people than the ones who sacrificed themselves today.
Are you willing to suffer for the sake of ending others' pain?
...You make it sound as if I have no other choice but to suffer.
We are a single entity, after all.
Your confusion is my confusion.
Your pain is my pain.
And your destruction...also entails my demise.
I have already done what I could to point out the best choice for you.
After a moment of silence, M4's lips curl into a bitter smile.
This might just be the only thing you've ever said that didn't sound like a lie.
I've been trying very hard to make you accept my existence.
Now don't get the wrong idea. I'm still very bothered by the fact that an unwelcome being has taken up residence in my neural cloud.
But...having seen all this, I finally realize that under these circumstances, I am woefully underpowered on my own.
My strength is so inadequate I can't even protect others properly.
Which is why I must borrow whatever I can. I need Task Force DEFY, the Commander, and even you to lend me your strength.
Then are you prepared to face your destiny?
Before I do that...I must first complete the assignment given by Ange.
Also, I...I'm starting to understand her urge to do unnecessary things.
In any case, it is ultimately my choice whether I decide to obey my orders or heed your advice.
I'll look forward to seeing the choice you make, whatever it may be.
The lonely figure of a Doll flits through the deserted streets, with the wall towering behind her back.
Her gaze no longer wavers. Instead, she makes for the rendezvous point with great determination.
It isn't over yet.
Even though the wall has been breached, brave soldiers are dying by the masses, and the storm saturated with radiation is howling like a triumphant march of victory for the enemy...
To her, this battle is far from over.
